name: bilateralbound
description: A scalable real-time multiplayer game built with SOLID principles

scripts.build:pages: echo '✅ Static files are served by Node.js server' && mkdir -p dist && cp -r public/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'No public files to copy'
scripts.dev:open: PORT=3000 npm start & sleep 2 && open http://localhost:3000 && wait
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:automated
scripts.test:server: node -c server/index.js && echo '✅ Server syntax OK'
scripts.test:full: npm run test && npm run health-test
scripts.health-test: sleep 2 && curl -s http://localhost:3000/health | jq .status 2>/dev/null || echo '❌ Health check failed'
scripts.status: curl -s http://localhost:3000/health || echo '❌ Server not running'
scripts.quick-start: echo '🚀 Запуск сервера...' && npm run dev:open
scripts.version:patch: node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); const v = pkg.version.split('.'); pkg.version = v[0] + '.' + v[1] + '.' + (parseInt(v[2]) + 1); require('fs').writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2)); console.log('📦 Version bumped to', pkg.version);"
scripts.version:minor: node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); const v = pkg.version.split('.'); pkg.version = v[0] + '.' + (parseInt(v[1]) + 1) + '.0'; require('fs').writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2)); console.log('📦 Version bumped to', pkg.version);"
scripts.version:major: node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); const v = pkg.version.split('.'); pkg.version = (parseInt(v[0]) + 1) + '.0.0'; require('fs').writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2)); console.log('📦 Version bumped to', pkg.version);"
scripts.postversion: git add package.json VERSION.md && git commit -m "🔖 Release v$(node -e "console.log(require('./package.json').version)")" && git tag v$(node -e "console.log(require('./package.json').version)")

author: BilateralBound Team
